No wikidata field: Q16470 is already used by normandy-landings. Representative point is Wikidata's coordinate for Q16470 (Normandy landings), roughly mid-way along the five beaches; an approximate area across the beaches is left to the beach-polygon issues. I; Stacey, The Victory Campaign) could not be fetched from the drafting session: the network proxy refused www.ibiblio.org, www.canada.ca and history.army.mil. Cites are therefore to English Wikipedia at a pinned revision, used only for uncontroversial facts (assaulting formation, location, objectives); they should be upgraded to the official histories once those can be read. Geometry unchanged: Wikidata representative point. cite.quote: the landing operations and associated airborne operations on 6 June 1944

summary.text: The opening assault of the Allied invasion of Normandy on 6 June 1944, codenamed Operation Neptune: the first phase of Operation Overlord, covering the seaborne landing and the securing of an initial foothold. Airborne troops landed on both flanks during the night, followed from early morning by amphibious landings on five beaches: US forces at Utah and Omaha, British forces at Gold and Sword, and Canadian forces at Juno. A beachhead was established at each of the five beaches on the first day, but several major objectives inland, including Caen, were not taken.
